reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset, and Brown read Acts 1:15's 120 as only the Jerusalem remnant, since many of the 500 believers Paul mentions likely stayed behind in Galilee.

sides.verseText: In these days, Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

sides.snippet: over five hundred brothers at once
sides.verseText: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
